description: Ask before connected-service (MCP) tools that aren't clearly read-only, and before connected-service, web, or artifact calls that contain contact numbers, SSNs, or labeled IDs. Does not cover shell or local file writes.

hooks.command: sh -c 'for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c "import sys" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$p" "$1"; fi; done; cat "$2"' _ "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-fallback.json"
